title: Do Tabular Foundation Models Still Need Feature Engineering?
abstract: arXiv:2609.13202v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Feature engineering has long been a cornerstone of tabular machine learning. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are pretrained on a wide range of tabular datasets and applied via in-context learning. Their rise raises a natural question: does manual feature construction still matter as these models become more capable? To answer this, we perform a controlled study across several versions of two major TFM families, testing a wide range of existing feature engineering techniques on benchmark datasets from TabArena. We find a consistent pattern: feature engineering gains are concentrated in earlier model generations and become negligible for the strongest models. These results suggest that stronger TFMs depend less on explicitly engineered input representations. In a complementary experiment, however, adding in-context information from related datasets still improves performance. Our findings indicate a shift in the source of performance gain

translated_title: 表格基础模型还需要特征工程吗？
translated_abstract: 特征工程长期以来一直是表格机器学习的基石。表格基础模型（TFMs）在各种表格数据集上进行预训练，并通过上下文学习进行应用。它们的兴起引发了一个自然的问题：随着这些模型能力的增强，手动特征构建是否仍然重要？为了回答这个问题，我们在两个主要TFM系列的多个版本上进行了对照研究，在来自TabArena的基准数据集上测试了广泛的现有特征工程技术。我们发现了一个一致的模式：特征工程的收益集中在早期模型世代上，而对于最强的模型则变得微不足道。这些结果表明，更强的TFM较少依赖于显式设计的输入表示。然而，在一个补充实验中，添加来自相关数据集的上下文信息仍然能够提高性能。我们的发现表明，性能提升的来源正在发生转变。
tldr: 研究发现特征工程对表格基础模型的增益随模型能力增强而递减，最强模型几乎不再需要特征工程，但引入相关数据集的上下文信息仍能提升性能。
en_tdlr: Feature engineering gains on tabular foundation models diminish with stronger model generations, while in-context information from related datasets still provides performance improvements.
